_comment: Config for jobspy_scan_parser.py (JobSpy multi-board scraper -> career-ops scan).
Query syntax matters: Indeed searches the DESCRIPTION as well as the title, and it
does NOT handle parenthesised OR groups — '"ml engineer" OR "ai engineer" ("new grad"
OR "entry level")' returned nurses and hairstylists in testing. Keep each search to one
quoted phrase + a couple of qualifier words + '-' exclusions, and add searches rather
Site list is 'indeed' only, measured on 2026-08-05 from this host:
linkedin      - excluded on purpose. Webscrapper/webscrapper.py already scrapes it as
its own local_parser, and LinkedIn rate-limits hard when two scrapers
zip_recruiter - HTTP 403 on every request (Cloudflare); needs the 'proxies' list.
google        - 0 rows; Google Jobs needs the exact search string its UI produces,
which changes often. Tune google_search_term before re-enabling.
glassdoor     - 'location not parsed' for country-level locations; needs a city.
Re-enable any of them per search with a 'sites' key on that search entry.
hours_old falls back to portals.yml scan_options.posted_within_hours when null.
Indeed limitation: hours_old cannot be combined with job_type/is_remote/easy_apply.
Title, location and blacklist filtering is NOT done here — scan.mjs applies portals.yml
to whatever this parser emits, exactly as it does for every other provider.
